card.headline: Stop saying "very happy"
card.sub: Say "thrilled" - or one of 9 other words

beats.speech: Stop saying very happy. Say thrilled. Need another word for happy? Here are ten: five for good news, and five for happy people and happy times.

beats.label: good news
beats.speech: Part 1. Five words for how you feel about good news.

card.headline: Thrilled
card.meaning: very happy and excited about something

beats.speech: Thrilled. It means very happy and excited about something. "I'm thrilled with my new job."
Delighted. It means very pleased. "We're delighted to see you."

card.headline: Overjoyed
card.meaning: extremely happy about something that happened

beats.speech: Overjoyed. It means extremely happy about something that happened. "She was overjoyed at the news."

card.headline: Ecstatic
card.meaning: extremely happy and full of excitement
card.example: "The fans were ecstatic when the team won."

beats.speech: Ecstatic. It means extremely happy and full of excitement. "The fans were ecstatic when the team won."

card.headline: Elated
card.meaning: very happy and excited, often because of a success
card.example: "He was elated after passing the exam."

beats.speech: Elated. It means very happy and excited, often because of a success. "He was elated after passing the exam."

card.headline: Which word is it?
card.question: Very happy and excited, often because of a success: ___
card.answer: Very happy and excited, often because of a success: elated

beats.speech: Which word is it? Very happy and excited, often because of a success. Elated, or delighted? | Elated. He was elated after passing the exam.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
I'm thrilled with my new job.
We're delighted to see you.
She was overjoyed at the news.
The fans were ecstatic when the team won.
He was elated after passing the exam.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | I'm thrilled with my new job. | We're delighted to see you. | She was overjoyed at the news. | The fans were ecstatic when the team won. | He was elated after passing the exam.

beats.label: happy people and times
beats.speech: Part 2. Five words for happy people and happy times.

card.headline: Joyful
card.meaning: very happy, or making people very happy

beats.speech: Joyful. It means very happy, or making people very happy. "The wedding was a joyful day."

card.headline: Radiant
card.meaning: so happy that it shows in your face

beats.speech: Radiant. It means so happy that it shows in your face. "She gave us a radiant smile."

card.headline: Jubilant
card.meaning: showing great happiness because of a win or a success

beats.speech: Jubilant. It means showing great happiness because of a win or a success. "Jubilant crowds filled the streets."

card.headline: Blissful
card.example: "We spent a blissful week at the beach."

beats.speech: Blissful. It means extremely happy and peaceful. "We spent a blissful week at the beach."

card.headline: Euphoric
card.meaning: extremely happy and excited, usually for a short time
card.example: "She felt euphoric when she crossed the finish line."

beats.speech: Euphoric. It means extremely happy and excited, usually for a short time. "She felt euphoric when she crossed the finish line."
Which word is it? Extremely happy and peaceful. Blissful, or jubilant? | Blissful. We spent a blissful week at the beach.

card.headline: Repeat after me
card.sentences:
The wedding was a joyful day.
She gave us a radiant smile.
Jubilant crowds filled the streets.
We spent a blissful week at the beach.
She felt euphoric when she crossed the finish line.

beats.speech: Now say them out loud with me. | The wedding was a joyful day. | She gave us a radiant smile. | Jubilant crowds filled the streets. | We spent a blissful week at the beach. | She felt euphoric when she crossed the finish line.
Quick tip: whenever you need another word for any word, look it up on another word for dot net.

card.headline: Which word will you use next time?

beats.speech: That's ten words to use instead of very happy. Which one will you use next time? Write it in the comments.
